description: §14.8.9 S441 round 4 (F1) — `M.get(c).v` over a Map keyed by characters rebuilds the hash; the element selected by a protected key is protected all the way down. E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED after round 3: `.get(k)`'s key taint reached only the scalar part, so a field read off the selected value dropped it and this served the hash (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar, S441 round 4 review).
